### Borea v0.5.1

A patch release for KSA 2026.10.19.5638. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### For players

##### Mod loader

- Borea now says when the installed StarMap does not support your KSA build, and offers the release that does with one click: on Home, before Play, on the instance page and in Settings > Game.
- Play asks first: Update and play, Play anyway, or Cancel.
- When no StarMap release fits your build yet, Home and Play say so, and Home says to update KSA when StarMap needs a newer build.
- A newer StarMap release that fits your game shows on Home, and you can close that banner.
- "Use existing" now records the StarMap version, so Borea no longer asks to reinstall it.
- Borea never updates StarMap by itself, never while KSA runs, and never to a release that your mods do not accept.

##### When the game does not start

- When a mod made for an older KSA stops StarMap, Borea names that mod, also when StarMap's output is cut short.
- The message also names the other enabled mods that need parts of KSA that this version does not have, and one click disables all of them.
- When StarMap itself was made for another KSA build, Borea says so and links the StarMap releases.
- A missing file that is not part of KSA, such as 0Harmony, no longer blames StarMap or a mod.

##### Saves and backups

- Borea does not restore a backup, or rename, copy or delete a save or a vehicle, while KSA runs, also when you started KSA outside Borea.

#### Command line

- `borea loader install` installs the newest StarMap release that supports your game, and `borea launch` warns about one that does not.
- When StarMap stops at start, `borea launch` names the mod in the same way as the App, or the install command when StarMap was made for another KSA build.

#### Good to know

- This version is tested with KSA 2026.10.19.5638.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.
